summary: Tested BGLIS v1.0 Phone Authentication feature. All 14 backend API tests pass (100%). Fixed two bugs during testing: (1) Missing Header import in bglis.py causing auth to fail, (2) Missing decode_token method in jwt_service.py. Frontend UI verification flow works correctly when user has valid session. One integration bug found: listing detail page doesn't show PhoneVerifiedBadge because seller_phone_verified is stored at listing creation time instead of being looked up from current user status.

integration_issues.issue: Badge doesn't appear because seller_phone_verified is stored at listing creation time, not fetched from seller's current is_phone_verified status

action_items: Update /api/local-exchange/listings/{listing_id} endpoint to fetch seller's current is_phone_verified status from banibs_users collection instead of using stored seller_phone_verified
Update messaging API to include otherUserPhoneVerified field in conversation responses by looking up user's is_phone_verified status
critical_code_review_comments: The local_exchange.py serialize_listing() function uses listing.get('seller_phone_verified', False) which is stale data stored at listing creation time
Need to join with banibs_users collection to get real-time seller verification status
